# Status

The status summary of a node. `osapi behavior get --name status` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same. [Its chain](../../chains/status.md)
shows each call that its examples make.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Description | Get the status summary of the host                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Detail      | Runs the get of the hostname, uptime, os, load, memory and disk behaviors on the host, and answers with each. A read that fails is in errors, as its name and its error, and the other fields still answer. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/status                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Permission  | status:read                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Command     | [osapi client node status get](../../../usage/cli/client/node/status/get.md)                                                                                                                                |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Output type | Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (7)

| FIELD        | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION                                                           |
| ------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string | The hostname of the host, as the hostname command prints it           |
| uptime       | object | How long the host has run                                             |
| os_info      | object | The operating system                                                  |
| load_average | object | The load averages of the host                                         |
| memory       | object | The memory of the host                                                |
| disks        | array  | Each local filesystem                                                 |
| errors       | array  | Each read that failed, as name: error. The other fields still answer. |
